sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I'm leaving the station when I reach for my scarf.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It's gone, and it's the one Mum gave me.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I turn back and spot a Lost Property sign.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Hi, has anyone handed in a scarf this afternoon?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: A few people have. What does yours look like?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's blue and green, and it's made of wool.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Okay, where do you think you left it?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: On a bench near the screen with the train times.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Right, let me have a look in the box here.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: I've got a photo of myself wearing it, if that helps.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, that would be useful. Can you show me?

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I open a photo from the first day of my trip.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Here, I'm wearing it in front of the museum.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: I've got a blue one here, with thin green stripes at both ends.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Sorry, what colour are the stripes?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Green stripes on a blue scarf.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: That sounds like mine. It's a long striped scarf.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Before I show you, is there anything else I can check?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: My name's on the label, in Mum's handwriting.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: She put it there because I always leave things behind.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: What's the name, please?

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: It's Lily Chen. The writing's quite small.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He checks one end, then turns the scarf over.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Yes, there it is. Lily Chen.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Oh, I'm so glad. I thought I'd lost it for good.

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Just write your name here to say you've picked it up.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Of course. Can I use this pen?

sentences.speaker: staff
sentences.text: Go ahead. Here you are, and keep warm out there.

sentences.speaker: traveler
sentences.text: Thanks for looking. Mum will be pleased too.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I put the scarf on before I leave the station.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Outside, I send Mum a photo with it safely round my neck.
